mapper.sql: id, task_type, biz_key, scope_key, payload_json, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, available_at, claimed_at, finished_at, worker_id, last_error, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mt_async_task WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE mt_async_task SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = #{retryCount}, available_at = #{availableAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, worker_id = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, update_time = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND task_type = #{taskType} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT task_type, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= #{currentTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ready_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DEAD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count FROM mt_async_task GROUP BY task_type ORDER BY task_type ASC
